# Prompt Anatomy - US HR hiring prompts and PDF guides

> Prompt Anatomy publishes free copy-paste AI prompts and paid PDF playbooks that help US HR teams run a repeatable hiring loop (Diagnose, Define, Source, Screen, Offer, Onboard). Operated by Tomas Staniulis from Alameda, CA. Site is English-only; paid PDFs delivered via Stripe with 14-day refund.

## Free resources
- [Landing - 10 free prompts and 6-phase workflow](https://www.promptanatomy.help/en/)
- [Full prompt digest (markdown)](https://www.promptanatomy.help/llms-full.txt)
